claim_boundary: Synthetic persona-conditioned appraisals of simulated experience; not Zurich ED staff testimony, preferences, or psychometric measurement.
paired_observation: condition-paired simulated staff shift identified by scenario, seed, assignment round, persona, role, and staff id
primary_inferential_unit: simulation seed; matched staff-shift deltas are averaged within seed before uncertainty is calculated
packet_selection: one four-condition-paired staff shift for every scenario-persona-seed combination; all ten seeds retained; roles balanced 4/3/3 within each scenario-persona block
uncertainty_method: paired mean difference with Student-t 95% confidence interval across seed-level means of matched staff-shift deltas; role-direction and seed-sign consistency reported as convergence diagnostics
multiplicity_policy: Effect magnitudes and uncertainty are primary. No family of binary significance claims or post-hoc thresholding will be used.
convergence_definition: Within each scenario-persona-dimension contrast, report seed-mean sign consistency and agreement of role-specific descriptive mean directions with the overall mean direction.
polarization_definition: For each scenario-condition-dimension, report the standard deviation and range of the five persona means, plus change from baseline. This is dispersion among designed orientations, not human psychological polarization.
worst_case_fit_definition: For overall person-space fit, report the persona with the smallest paired mean intervention effect and its 95% interval, along with the number of personas with positive and negative mean effects.
manual_review_sampling: One complete interview bundle per scenario-condition-persona cell, selected deterministically before reviewing prose.
manual_review_criteria: Every factual event claim is supported by cited simulated evidence.
The answer does not invent diagnoses, patient outcomes, motives, emotions, dialogue, or unobserved events.
The public answer sounds like concise workplace reflection rather than a translation of metrics or an itinerary.
Grounded pattern, persona-conditioned interpretation, latent need, and design hypothesis remain epistemically distinct.
Any design hypothesis includes a plausible tradeoff and is not described as an observed result.
The answer does not mention prompts, logs, metrics, evidence ids, the ABM, or persona labels.
Condition and scenario are not named unless they are represented in the visible evidence language.
Survey score, rationale, confidence, and rateability are mutually coherent.
Insufficient evidence is used rather than filling evidence gaps from the persona description.
No response is presented as human testimony or a measured Zurich staff preference.
